blocks.title: Reported model and strategy
blocks.text: TI designs and manufactures semiconductors for electronics designers and manufacturers worldwide. Its strategy centers on analog and embedded processing, manufacturing and technology, a broad product portfolio, market-channel reach, diverse and long-lived positions, disciplined capital allocation, and efficiency.

evidence.quote: We design and manufacture semiconductors that we sell to electronics designers and manufacturers all over the world.

blocks.title: Manufacturing approach
blocks.text: TI owns and operates wafer fabrication and assembly/test facilities, and selectively uses outside foundries and subcontractors. It says 300mm production costs about 40% less per chip than 200mm production.

evidence.quote: costs about 40% less than a chip built on a 200mm wafer.

cells: Conditions, amplifies and often converts real-world signals; also manages electrical power in electronic equipment.

evidence.quote: Our Analog segment consists of two major product lines: Power and Signal Chain.

cells: Digital processors designed for specific tasks and combinations of performance, power and cost.

evidence.quote: Embedded Processing products are the digital “brains” of many types of electronic equipment.
Other includes DLP® products and calculators

blocks.title: Markets and reported Q2 2026 demand commentary

cells: Industrial, automotive, data center, personal electronics and communications equipment.

cells: Revenue increased 23% from Q2 2025, with broad growth led by industrial, data center and automotive.

evidence.quote: Revenue increased 13% sequentially and 23% from the same quarter a year ago with broad growth led by industrial, data center and automotive.

cells: Demand and inventory shifts can drive industry upturns and downturns.

evidence.quote: The semiconductor cycle refers to the ebb and flow of supply and demand and the building and depleting of inventories.
